name: scripts
description: Manifest for .github/scripts/ (copy it there with the scripts). "type": "commonjs" is what lets the CommonJS scripts run under a root package.json declaring "type": "module". It also makes every .js file here CommonJS, a project's own included: rename an ES-module one to .mjs, and re-run your own guards after installing this. The dependency is for the scheduled-task notifier: run `npm install` here only with that kit.
